findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - initialize an app from either starter and run eslint . with its generated configuration.

The new blanket disable produces an unused-disable warning in live-browser-session.js and live-browser-ignores.js, in both host copies. These helpers otherwise satisfy the starters' rules and browser/node globals (src/forge/templates/starter/eslint.config.mjs:9–11 and starter-python/eslint.config.mjs:8–10). [ESLint 9.38 defaults to reporting unused disable directives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eslint/eslint/v9.38.0/lib/config/default-config.js), so the promised absence of problems remains unmet even though warnings normally leave the exit status zero. This is additional evidence not addressed by the coordinator's recommendation to annotate all five files.

The regression misses this because tests/test_shipped_scripts_lint.py:38 replaces both starter configurations with one lacking browser globals: its artificial window errors make these disable comments appear necessary. Preserve the real starter configurations when checking this case and address the unused directives.
